description: Spawns an agent that wires a new renderable category into the editor's asset pipeline: slots.json category + selector node + the right import path.

fields.description: New data/slots.json category key (lowercase, snake_case). Sets the selector tree node and the branch slug.
fields.label: Category key

fields.description: Label shown on the selector tree node.
fields.label: Display name

fields.description: Frame width in px for the category's slots (buildings/enemies 64, map tiles 64, ui/vfx 64).
fields.label: Frame width

fields.description: Frame height in px (buildings/enemies/deco/core 96, map tiles 32, ui/vfx 64).
fields.label: Frame height

fields.description: False = idle-only slot (imported via asset_import.import_idle_sheet). True = real animation vocabulary, imported through the DetailsPanel rows. List the animation names in the box above.
fields.label: Animated (multi-row)
